QuestInfo.name: [Halloween] Prank or Treat
QuestInfo.0: Ghosts have appeared in Maple World to celebrate Halloween! There's a rumor that if you don't give them treats, they'll prank you super hard. Maybe Cassandra will know more.
QuestInfo.1: Hunt down monsters around your level to find 50 Halloween Candies for Cassandra.
QuestInfo.2: With this candy sacrifice, you should be safe from ghosts. Maybe...

0.0: #b#h0##k! We have a problem. A bunch of no-goodnick ghosts are pranking up a storm unless they get their fill of candy. One of them glued all of my hair driers to the ceiling last night. Do you know how hard it is to get a proper tease upside down?! Surprisingly easy, but still...

yes.0: I knew you cared about Maple World... and candy. Monsters usually carry around the #rHalloween Candies#k that ghosts crave!
yes.1: Oh, and I don't think any monsters who are #bmore than 10 levels below you or 20 levels above you will have the good stuff#k. Good luck!

no.0: Ugh, these ghosts are just messing up Maple World, and you're gonna let it happen? Why do they like even pranks so much? They're dead!

default.0: Um, I need 50 Halloween Candies or they're going to plastic wrap my entire bathroom. Hurry it up!
